minor.issue: FIXED by test agent — _search_manual + answer-builder crashed with TypeError when manual block.items contained dicts (not strings). Patched to coerce items via a local _item_str helper that reads .text/.content/.label.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by test agent — ReferenceError 'logo is not defined' crashed the ENTIRE console on every page. critical_code_review_comments: ConsoleLayout.jsx had a build-breaking regression — `site` and `logo` referenced without declaration (iter28 feature #3 was shipped incomplete). This crashed every console route including /console/dashboard. Would have been caught by a 10-second manual smoke test by the main agent.

server.py _search_manual assumes block.items is List[str] but the manual_modules seed produces List[Dict]. Also crashes if items is e.g. a nested list. The _item_str coercion added handles str/dict; could be hardened further.

ai_ask manual-first logic logs ONLY when hit is None (manual_gaps). If the manual branch raises an exception (as it did), the request 500s silently — wrap the entire manual block in try/except with logger.exception + continue to tool/LLM fallback.

POST /analytics/events is UNAUTHENTICATED and takes a free-form Dict[str, Any] with no size/rate-limit — public endpoint that writes to db.events. Risk: trivial DoS via unbounded event spam. Add rate limit per visitor_id + payload size cap + Pydantic schema.
GET /analytics/funnel aggregates in Python over up to 50k rows per request — fine at MVP scale, but should be a Mongo aggregation pipeline before 1M+ events.
/public/site returns full site_settings dict including DEFAULT_SECTIONS fallback — ensure no secrets ever get added to that collection since it's unauthenticated.
ReviewModerationIn.status is a free-form `str` — should be Literal['approved','rejected','pending'] to prevent moderators from writing arbitrary values.

rca of the issue: Bug 1 (frontend blocker): main agent shipped ConsoleLayout refactor referencing undefined identifiers `site` and `logo` (JSX lines 148-149, 193-194) — ReferenceError at render killed the entire /console/* tree. Reproduction: open ANY console page → Emergent runtime-error overlay 'logo is not defined'. Mitigation: added useState({}) + /public/site fetch effect + local `logo` derivation. Bug 2 (backend 500): _search_manual iterated block.items with ' '.join() but items in db.manual_modules are dicts {text:..., content:...}, not strings → TypeError('sequence item 0: expected str instance, dict found') → POST /ai/ask returned 500 for any how-to question matching the manual. Mitigation: added _item_str coercion in BOTH the search (score computation) and answer builder.
